title: ExceptionNotice
description: Interim filing, due within the notice deadline (default 72 hours) of detecting an event that matches a declared pause criterion or any third-party compromise. Closes the gap between a fast incident and a 30-day closeout cadence. It records detection; it does not detect.

schema_version.description: The schema version the filing is written against.

record_type.description: The record type. It fixes which schema and which checks apply.

notice_id.description: Identifier of the notice. The run's Closeout lists it in notice_ids.

run_id.description: The run the events happened in. Give run_id or system_id, not both.

system_id.description: The deployed system the events happened in, for an incident after deployment. Give run_id or system_id, not both.

filed_at.description: When the notice was filed: within the notice deadline (default 72 hours) of detected_at.

detected_at.description: When the developer detected the events.

event_ids.description: Identifiers that the run's Closeout will use for the same events.

criterion_ids.description: The Intent's pause criteria the events matched, if any.

action_taken.description: What the filer did in response. none records that nothing was done.
